title: Light German Porridge Pilaf
description: A tangy and refreshing German-inspired pilaf dish made with porridge oats, pickles, and a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: Dill pickle
ingredients.notes: Chopped or sliced, whichever you prefer

instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a medium saucepan over medium heat until simmering.
Add the mustard seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the sugar-free maple syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped pickle and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the porridge oats and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and lemon juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
Let sit for 2-3 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
